climb_fuel_source: Piper PA-28-181 Cherokee Archer II POH (VB-790, 1976), figure 5-15, time, distance and fuel to climb (76 KIAS, full throttle, 2550 lb), its example: 2,000 ft to 6,000 ft in 8 min on 2 gal, so 15 GPH; the chart's start, taxi and takeoff allowance cancels in the difference. The Archer III POH (VB-2266, 2013), figure 5-17, gives 2 gal in 9 min (13.3 GPH); both round to whole gallons, and the higher burn is taken, erring toward more fuel

crosswind.source: Piper PA-28-181 Archer POH, section 4: maximum demonstrated crosswind velocity
